Err.CallNameLength: The name to call is too long (60 characters at most).
Err.LineNoteLength: An item note is too long (200 characters at most).
Err.MenuNotEmpty: A sample menu can only be added while the menu is empty.
Err.StationNameRequired: Give the station a name (for example Kitchen or Bar).
Err.StationNameTaken: There is already a station called "{0}".
Err.StationNotFound: That station no longer exists. Reopen the page and try again.
Features.Hint.KitchenTickets: Each order prints a ticket at the kitchen, the bar or any other station that makes it. A ticket that fails to print waits on the Kitchen page.
Features.Hint.OrderNumbers: Every order gets a number, starting again at 1 each day, printed on the receipt and the kitchen ticket.
Features.Hint.Takeaway: The till asks whether the order is eaten here or taken away. It can be switched on for some tills only.
FirstRun.SampleMenu: Start with a sample menu for this kind of place
FirstRun.SampleMenuHint: Example items, prices and options to try the till with. Change or delete them any time on the Menu page.
Kitchen.LoadFailed: The kitchen tickets couldn't be loaded.
Kitchen.NoPrinter: No printer is set for this station (Settings → Kitchen and bar printers).
Kitchen.NotPrinted: {0} kitchen ticket(s) didn't print. They are waiting on the Kitchen page.
Kitchen.PcPrinterTip: Only this till: leave it on "Same as the store" unless this PC prints the station somewhere else.
Kitchen.PrinterNotFound: The printer "{0}" isn't installed on this PC.
Kitchen.PrinterOffline: The printer "{0}" is off or not connected.
Kitchen.PrinterProblem: The printer "{0}" needs attention (paper, cover or error).
Kitchen.StationsHint: Each menu item is made at a station; its tickets print at that station's printer. Choose the station on each item in the Menu.
Kitchen.StorePrinterTip: The printer every till sends this station's tickets to.
Menu.StationHint: Its kitchen ticket prints at this station. Choose "No ticket" for things handed over as they are, like a can of soda.
Register.LineNotePrompt: Note for the kitchen about "{0}" (for example: no onions):
Register.LineNoteTip: Add a note for the kitchen to the selected item
